All players: Grid game with 4 pricing blocks. Owners share a single battery of capacity 10 MWh that carries over across blocks and days. In each block, price is 20 (night), 50 (morning), 90 (peak), 60 (evening), repeating. Price can be reduced by +/-2 per MWh of net discharge over total charges. So if my neighbors discharge more than I charge, my realized price drops. Key insight: the realized price is a function of NET discharge minus total charge across ALL owners, not just myself.
